policy: Do not add translations for building-focused or decoration-focused mods, including their dedicated manuals. Preserve existing upstream, CFPA and project translations. Exclusions do not remove integration-pack quest text or necessary cross-mod explanations from scope. Gameplay or technology mods are not excluded merely for containing decorative blocks. Verify the main purpose and namespaces of newly encountered building or decoration mods before updating this list. See AGENTS.md for workflow and scope rules.
